name: gs1-product
label: GS1 Product Ontology
description: GS1 product identification — used by Google Shopping, Amazon, major retailers

table_notes.gs1_product: Core product registry keyed by GTIN; holds identity, classification, physical measurements, and multilingual content as JSONB.
table_notes.gs1_product_attribute: Extensible key-value store for GS1 product attributes not captured in the core table, supporting per-language and per-UOM values.
table_notes.gs1_product_image: Stores all product image URLs for a GTIN with type and facing metadata for planogram and packaging use cases.
table_notes.gs1_allergen_declaration: EU FIR 1169/2011-compliant allergen declarations per GTIN, recording allergen type and level of containment.

gs1_product.name: gtin
gs1_product.description: Global Trade Item Number (GS1 standard) — 14-digit padded identifier for the trade item

gs1_product.name: product_name
gs1_product.description: Multilingual product name as {"en": "...", "fr": "..."} keyed by ISO 639-1 language code

gs1_product.name: brand_name
gs1_product.description: Brand or manufacturer name as registered with GS1

gs1_product.name: gpc_category_code
gs1_product.description: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) brick code — 8-digit numeric category identifier

gs1_product.name: gpc_category_name
gs1_product.description: Human-readable name of the GPC brick category (e.g. Breakfast Cereals)

gs1_product.name: description
gs1_product.description: Multilingual product description as {"en": "...", "fr": "..."} keyed by ISO 639-1 language code

gs1_product.name: net_content
gs1_product.description: Numeric quantity of product contents (volume, weight, count); unit in net_content_uom

gs1_product.name: net_content_uom
gs1_product.description: Unit of measure for net_content using UN/CEFACT common code (e.g. GRM, MLT, EA)

gs1_product.name: gross_weight_kg
gs1_product.description: Total weight of the trade item including packaging, in kilograms

gs1_product.name: country_of_origin
gs1_product.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country where the product was manufactured or grown

gs1_product.name: target_market
gs1_product.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric country code of the intended sales market (GS1 target market)

gs1_product.name: images
gs1_product.description: Array of image objects [{"url": "...", "type": "FRONT", "facing": "FRONT"}] for quick access

gs1_product.name: linked_data_uri
gs1_product.description: GS1 SmartSearch / schema.org linked data URI for this product (used by Google Shopping)

gs1_product.name: created_at
gs1_product.description: Timestamp when this product record was first inserted

gs1_product_attribute.name: gtin
gs1_product_attribute.description: References gs1_product.gtin; identifies which product this attribute belongs to

gs1_product_attribute.name: attribute_name
gs1_product_attribute.description: GS1 or custom attribute name (e.g. colourDescription, flavourDescription)

gs1_product_attribute.name: attribute_value
gs1_product_attribute.description: Value of the attribute; interpret according to attribute_name and uom

gs1_product_attribute.name: uom
gs1_product_attribute.description: UN/CEFACT unit of measure code for numeric attributes (e.g. CMT, GRM); NULL for text attributes

gs1_product_attribute.name: lang_code
gs1_product_attribute.description: ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language tag for localised text attributes (e.g. en, fr-CA)

gs1_product_image.name: gtin
gs1_product_image.description: References gs1_product.gtin; identifies which product this image belongs to

gs1_product_image.name: image_url
gs1_product_image.description: Fully qualified URL to the product image asset (CDN or origin)

gs1_product_image.name: image_type
gs1_product_image.description: GS1 image type code: FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, BOTTOM, or DETAIL

gs1_product_image.name: facing
gs1_product_image.description: Camera angle / shot type (e.g. FRONT_FACING, IN_USE, LIFESTYLE) per GS1 image guidelines

gs1_product_image.name: is_planogram
gs1_product_image.description: True if this image is intended for retail planogram use (whitebox / shelf-ready view)

gs1_allergen_declaration.name: gtin
gs1_allergen_declaration.description: References gs1_product.gtin; identifies which product carries this allergen declaration

gs1_allergen_declaration.name: allergen_type
gs1_allergen_declaration.description: GS1 allergen type code (e.g. AC for celery, AE for eggs, AW for wheat) per GS1 code list

gs1_allergen_declaration.name: level_of_containment
gs1_allergen_declaration.description: GS1 containment code: CONTAINS, MAY_CONTAIN, FREE_FROM, or UNDECLARED per EU FIR 1169/2011

short_description: GS1 product identification — used by Google Shopping, Amazon, major retailers
long_description: GS1 Product Ontology provides the complete product identification data model including GTIN codes, product attributes, images, and allergen declarations aligned with GS1 SmartSearch and GS1 Global Data Synchronisation Network (GDSN) standards. The schema matches what Google Shopping, Amazon Product Advertising API, and major retailers require for product listings.
when_to_use: Use for any e-commerce platform, product catalog, or retail inventory system that needs to interoperate with Google Shopping, Amazon Marketplace, Walmart Marketplace, or major grocery retailers. GS1 GTIN codes are required by all major retail platforms. The allergen declaration tables are required by EU Food Information Regulation (FIR 1169/2011).
